paragraphs.text: One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotke
y launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board.
Human in the loop is the bottleneck.
Cetus is a desktop client for reviewing and managing the work of every agent you run — Claude Code,
Codex, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kimi CLI, or the built-in runtime.
Official website · cetus.run
English · 简体中文
## Community
⭐️ Star the repo to get notified about new releases. To share feedback, scan the QR code with WeChat
to join the group chat.
Friendly links
- LINUX DO — A community of idealists.
## Why Cetus
Agents are no longer the slow part. Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness can work for an hour on
their own. What slows them down is the person they are waiting on: a permission prompt, a clarifyin
g question, a finished task that nobody has reviewed yet.
And that person is usually juggling several products. Claude Code in one window, Codex in another, s
cheduled jobs that each report back in a different client. Every switch costs attention, and every m
inute you don't notice an agent waiting is a minute it sits idle.
Some tools, like Superset, put different runtimes side by side, but in a TUI. A terminal is a fine p
lace for an agent to run and a poor place for a person to read: everything is monospaced text, plans
, diffs, and questions all look alike, and whatever scrolls off is gone.
Cetus is built for the human side of the loop: a real desktop app where every agent's work is easy t
o read, easy to answer, and easy to review.
## One client for every runtime
- **Every runtime in one window.** Use the CLI you already have installed and signed in to. Cetus re

uses its login, model, and tools, so there is no second account to set up.
- **One place to respond.
** Permission prompts, questions, and plans from any runtime show up as cards in the conversation. S

teer a running turn or queue the next message without waiting for it to finish.
- **One board for re
view.** Every conversation is a card in **In progress · Needs review · Done**. Finished work waits f

or you instead of scrolling away in a terminal.
- **Parallel without collisions.** Per-conversation
git worktrees let several agents edit the same repo at once.
## Built around the same loop
Everything else in Cetus exists to make your part of the loop shorter.
### Threads — see all your sessions at once
A workspace feed where every message starts its own session, on whichever runtime you `@mention`. Op
en any thread docked beside the feed, and follow the activity badges to the next session that needs
ny thread docked beside the feed, and follow the activity badges to the next session that needs you.
### Quick Launcher — any runtime, one hotkey away
Hold **both ⌘ keys** to summon an agent over any app. Cetus brings along the current screenshot, fro
ntmost app, browser URL, and selected text as removable context chips, so you can ask in place inste
ad of switching windows and explaining what you are looking at.
### Automations — scheduled work lands in the same place
Turn any prompt into a one-off or recurring job (`at` / `every` / `cron` / `daily`) on any runtime.
Each run works in a fresh background conversation and lands on the board for review, instead of repo
rting back in yet another client.
### Less explaining
The less context you have to type, the faster you get back out of the loop.
- **Screen context.** Cetus captures frames, dedupes them, and OCRs them on-device with Apple Vision
, so the agent can recall what was on screen. Opt-in, with retention controls and an excluded-apps l

ist.
- **Meeting memory.** Calls are transcribed on-device into searchable notes — text only, no aud
io stored. Ask "what did we decide about the launch date?" and the agent searches your meetings loca

lly. Off by default.
- **Dictation.** Hold a hotkey in any app and talk; Cetus types the cleaned-up

text wherever your cursor is.
- **Persistent memory** that you and the agent both edit, carried into
future conversations.
### And more

- **Parallel solutions**: fan one prompt into N candidate runs, keep one, archive the rest
- **Cetus
Remote**, an optional Tailscale-backed phone companion for following runs and handling approvals aw

ay from your desk
- **Computer and browser control**, with a confirmation step before anything conse

quential and a Stop button always in reach
- **30+ model providers** for the built-in runtime, inclu
ding Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenRouter
Every capability that touches your screen, mic, or apps is opt-in, and everything stays on your Mac.
## Get started
Cetus runs on **Apple Silicon** Macs. There are two builds of the same app:
| Build | Download | Requires |

| **Cetus** — the original app, built with Electron | Cetus.dmg | macOS 13+ |
| **Cetus Swift** (Bet
a) — a native SwiftUI build, still missing some polish | Cetus-Swift.dmg | macOS 15+ |
Both update themselves. Then:

1. Open the DMG and move Cetus to Applications.
2. Use the built-in runtime, or pick an installed an

d signed-in `claude`, `codex`, or `dsh` (DeepSeek Harness) CLI.
3. Choose a workspace and give the a
gent its first task.
> **Early release:** Cetus is under active development. Please open an issue if something breaks or
a workflow is missing.
